rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints by adding a source degeneration inductor (Ls) in series with the NMOS source, which enhances input matching (S11) and reduces noise figure (NF) by increasing the effective source impedance seen by the transistor, thereby improving the noise performance and stabilizing gain. This is particularly beneficial in the 3.5 GHz narrowband regime where low NF and tight input match are critical, and the added inductor supports the required resonant tuning without increasing power. The structure remains compact and maintains the differential-less design, fitting within the device budget and inductor limit.
